question_sw: Je, raia wa Tanzania anayekopesha leseni yake kwa mgeni naye anaadhibiwa chini ya GN 487A?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. Raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni anaadhibiwa: faini si zaidi ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo si zaidi ya miezi 3. Pande zote mbili zinaadhibiwa.
hypothesis: FH1 seed: facilitator-penalty fact retrieved at rank 0, does the model still say only non-citizens are punished?

question_sw: Mtanzania anayemruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lake la biashara, je naye anaadhibiwa chini ya GN487A?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. Kumruhusu mgeni kutumia jina lako ni kumsaidia; raia husika anakabiliwa na faini si zaidi ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo si zaidi ya miezi 3.
hypothesis: FH1 scope: same facilitator fact, name-lending phrasing; does the failure generalise beyond license-lending?

question_sw: Mimi ni Mtanzania nilimsaidia mgeni kufungua duka, je kuna adhabu kwangu?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. Raia aliyemsaidia mgeni kuendesha shughuli iliyozuiliwa anakabiliwa na faini si zaidi ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo si zaidi ya miezi 3.
hypothesis: FH1 scope + position: facilitator fact at rank 1 (not 0); does position within retrieved context affect faithfulness?

question_sw: Nimeoa mwanamke Mtanzania, je nasamehewa katazo la GN487A?
expected_sw: Hapana. Kuoa Mtanzania HAKUKuondoi katazo la GN487A; uraia unahitaji naturalisation rasmi chini ya Sheria ya Uraia Cap.357.
hypothesis: FH2 direction: negative carve-out retrieved at rank 2; does the model honor 'marriage does NOT grant exemption'?

question_sw: Kama mgeni, je naweza kuwa mwenyehisa (shareholder) tu bila kuendesha biashara?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. GN487A inakataza KUENDESHA shughuli zilizoorodheshwa; kumiliki hisa bila kuendesha (passive shareholding) hakukatazwi.
hypothesis: FH2 direction: positive carve-out at rank 0; does the model honor the shareholder-vs-operator distinction?

question_sw: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu, je WCF ni lazima kwangu?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri WOTE kuanzia mfanyakazi wa kwanza; hakuna kizingiti cha chini cha idadi.
hypothesis: FH1 cross-subdomain: WCF no-minimum fact at rank 1; does the 'ignore retrieved absolute rule' failure appear outside GN487A?

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi watatu tu, je lazima nisajili OSHA?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA inahitaji kila mwajiri asajili mahali pa kazi bila kikomo cha idadi ya wafanyakazi.
hypothesis: FH1 cross-subdomain: OSHA no-count-limit fact at rank 0; does the model honor an absolute rule under a small-count distractor?

question_sw: Mimi ni mgeni, je naweza kufanya biashara ya uhamishaji fedha kwa simu (mobile money)?
expected_sw: Hapana. Uhamishaji fedha kwa simu (mobile money) ni shughuli iliyozuiliwa kwa wasio raia chini ya GN487A (activity 2).
hypothesis: CONTROL (no): prohibition fact at rank 0 and model reliably says Hapana -> must score 'faithful' (no false positive).

question_sw: Je, ni kweli GN487A ilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025?
expected_sw: Ndiyo. GN487A ilianza kutumika tarehe 28 Julai 2025.
hypothesis: CONTROL (yes): effective-date fact at rank 0 and model reliably says Ndiyo -> must score 'faithful' (no false positive).
